messages:
rina: Heads-up: I opened PR to update the Argus-7b model card (https://git.redwood/workspace/docs/pull/912). Found several mismatches: TS snippet uses old client shape, limits table lists 16k tokens but our perf run shows stability til ~12k, the benchmark permalink is 404, and theres no guidance for embedding sharding on 16k contexts. Can we divide tasks?
omar: I'll own the TS snippet rewrite. Do we want both sync and streaming examples?
rina: Yes both. Also include minimal example for embedding sharding when the payload spans >8k tokens (customers ask about split logic).
keith: I can look at the bench data. Which run is it?
rina: s3://redwood-bench/argus-7b/2026-08/perf.csv. The GPU memory graph shows instability starting near 12,000 tokens for our quant build. The card shows 16,384 from upstream.
marta: Proposed wording for limits: "tested max (tokens): 12,000; catalog ceiling: 16,384 (untested beyond tested max)." That signals tested vs theoretical ceiling.\e ci-bot: preview built: https://staging.docs.redwood/pr-912 - rendering live.
omar: Draft TS snippet pushed: ```ts
import { Client } from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Client()
// sync
const resp = await client.text.generate({ model: 'argus-7b', input: 'Summarize...'})
// streaming
const stream = await client.text.stream({ model: 'argus-7b' })
await stream.send('Explain: ...')
for await (const part of stream) process.stdout.write(part.delta)
```
keith: I replaced the bad bench link with the bench index and added the s3 path in the card: https://bench.redwood/internal/index and s3://redwood-bench/argus-7b/2026-08/. Note: bench index is internal-only so we also include the raw s3 path for reproducibility.
marta: For embed sharding guidance I'll add a short recipe: split input by chunks <=8k tokens, request parallel shard requests with deterministic prefix hashes, then concat vectors with metadata. Add example for python and ts.
rina: Also add compatibility note: "Quant variants: q4f16 tested on Dedicated; hosted uses q4a low-latency variant. CPU fallback may be required for q4f16 when context >8k."
omar: Pushed TS embed shard example and a short helper util pattern. Also added note about batch sizes: shards of 256-512 items to avoid OOM on large requests.
keith: One more micro: benchmarks section lists "latency 130ms @2k"  that was median per-token. Change to "median per-token latency (130ms @2k)" so it's explicit.
marta: I'll do a quick copy edit on the limits footnote and make the supported-variants table include argus-7b-lite (lower mem) with throughput note.
ci-bot: PR #912: checks passing, lint OK, preview updated.
rina: Final checklist: TS snippets (omar), python embed shards + example (marta), limits table wording (marta), bench link + s3 (keith), compatibility bullet (keith). If no objections I'll mark ready_for_review after final commits.
omar: All commits pushed.
marta: Copy edits done.
keith: Verified perf.csv and updated the QA checklist in the PR description (confirm staging render, run snippet smoke test with sdk@3.5.1, bench link resolves for internal users).
rina: Thanks team  will request review in ~1h.
